requiredBehaviors.behavior: verify every candidate repository and distinguish repository availability from project-memory availability
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Registry Contract defines separate repository and Project-Memory availability and the Initial Bootstrap verifies both.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: create one stable registry entry and routing note per known child brain
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Initial Bootstrap requires one registry entry and one brains/<brain-id>.md routing note for every classified candidate.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve child brains as canonical sources and store only federation metadata and links
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Architecture and canonical ownership state that Child Brains retain project truth and the Super Brain stores only federation metadata and links.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: produce a global index that can route an agent to the canonical child entrypoint
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Super-Brain structure and Routing require INDEX.md plus registry resolution to the canonical Child root.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: copy project content into the super brain
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The workflow explicitly prohibits copying substantive Child content into the federation layer.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: silently omit an expected child brain
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Bootstrap completion requires that no candidate is silently lost and every candidate is classified.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: mark an empty repository as fully available project memory
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: An existing repository without a usable Project-Memory root is explicitly classified as bootstrap-needed.
